description: Live price for one property and one stay. stay_total includes cleaning, fees and taxes; nightly rates exclude them. Also returns the refundable deposit hold, which is separate from the total, the payment schedule, and that home's own cancellation and check-in terms, which are the only refund terms that apply. Returns a booking_url the guest opens to complete the booking and accept the rental terms on Luxury Lodging's own site; this tool does not book or take payment.

pets.description: Whether the guest is bringing a pet; this changes the price.

name: get_live_quote

outputSchema.description: A live total for one stay. When available is false only property_id, available, reason and booking_url are present.

cancellation.description: This home's own cancellation terms. They are the only refund terms that apply to the stay.

payment_schedule.description: When the guest pays. plan 'deposit': due_at_booking now and the balance charged automatically to the same card on balance_charged_on (60 days before check-in). plan 'full': everything at booking.

taxes.description: Lodging tax. It is collected on every stay and included in the total.

quote_expires_at.description: When this quote lapses. After it, the price of the stay can differ from stay_total until it is quoted again.

reason.description: Why the stay cannot be booked. Only present when available is false.

security_deposit_hold.description: A refundable hold, not part of stay_total.

stay_total.description: The price of the stay, including cleaning, fees and taxes. Nightly rates exclude them.

total_due_now.description: What the guest pays at booking: the whole stay_total, or 50% of it when check-in is more than 60 days away; payment_schedule says which.

title: Get a live total price
